title: MedPruef mentor fact file (contract C6, frozen by W0-C0A on 2026-10-10)
description: Each data file in content/mentor-facts/ (sip.json, stichprobentest.json, pharma.json, general.json; owned by W2-FACTS) is a JSON array of fact records. Read ONLY through the C17 facts loader. Assertability rule: a fact may be asserted to a learner only when verdict == 'confirmed' AND status == 'live' AND (valid_until is absent OR valid_until >= today, Europe/Vienna); a fact past valid_until is treated as needs_review by the loader. Every date, deadline, fee or format value must come from a confirmed official row (C14) and pass research/check-dates.py. Postgraduate OeAEK facts stay out.

id.description: Stable, unique across all fact files, never reused after retraction. Convention: <exam_key>.<topic>.<slug>, e.g. sip5a.dates.nov-2026.

filing_university.description: Which filers the fact applies to. Stichprobentest cutoffs differ by publisher for the same sitting.

deadline_type.description: Only for deadline facts. filing_cutoff = last day to file the application (MedUni Wien Merkblatt); registration = last day to register for the sitting.

aliases.description: Learner phrasings the search_facts tool should match (DE, EN and common misspellings).

edition.description: Document edition or page state, e.g. 'Merkblatt, Stand 1 Sep 2026' or 'page read 2026-10-10'.

x-mentor-tools-frozen.get_dates: get_dates(exam_key, filing_university) -> upcoming OFFICIAL_SITTINGS (src/lib/exam-dates.ts, C7) plus assertable date facts
x-mentor-tools-frozen.search_facts: search_facts(query_de, exam_key?, topic?) -> assertable facts only
